description: This is an Android activity class named TechFilter, which handles NFC tag detection via the foreground dispatch system and updates the UI to reflect discovered NFC tags.

classes.name: TechFilter
classes.description: An Android Activity used to demonstrate NFC technology detection, updating a TextView with information about detected NFC tags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and handles the initial NFC intent to display information about discovered tags.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles newly received NFC intents when the activity is already running, updating the UI with new tag discovery info.
